For petitioner : Mr.V.Ramamurthy

 Government Advocate (Cr
 Order

The Writ Petition has been filed for a direction to the respondents not to interfere with the running of restaurant in the name of Drift Cafe & Restaurant (BRASS HAT LLP) along with herbal hookah service in No.260, Mount Casa Blanca, 1st floor, Thousand Light, Chennai, Tamil Nadu  600 006.
2.In
the similar circumstances

, this Court passed an order in Crl.OP.No.21020 of 2024 dated 23.10.2024, thereby directed the petitioner to submit a representation before the Food Safety and Standards Authority for the purpose of having a separate enclosure for herbal hookah for permission.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.In view of the above
, the petitioner is directed to approach the Food Safety and Standards Authority for the purpose of having a separate enclosure for herbal hookah in the petitioner's restaurant.
If the permission is granted to the petitioner, the petitioner can do hookah service in the restaurant.

Further, the 4th respondent is directed to inspect the premises of the petitioner to ensure whether the petitioner running the herbal hookah with the permission that is granted to him and if there is any violation, the 4th respondent is directed to take appropriate action against the petitioner in the manner known to law.
4.In the result, this Writ Petition is dismissed.
Consequently, the connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
No costs.
